about: Static corridor reference for rail.html. Only figures found in the public documents listed under sources are carried, each with its source id; a value that covers only part of a corridor carries its span, and a dated value carries its year. Map lines live in data/rail-geometry.json (Natural Earth railroads between cited stations); on-screen distances always use the cited figures.

thresholds.about: Row-state thresholds for the rail screen. silentHours: an observed container with no newer observation for this long gets a 'no new observation' note. dwellHours: a container whose latest observation sits at a gauge-change border for this long shows its dwell time.

collector.about: Scheduled collection rounds for rail containers (KST). Rail containers are looked up only in these rounds, so a newly registered container is looked up at the next round, never instantly. graceMin: how long after a round a still-unpolled row is called late. lateHours: if the newest round is older than this, the round schedule itself is reported as delayed. tierHours: how often one container is looked up once registered (the collector's poll tier: transit 12 h, otherwise 24 h; near 3 h applies only to dated shipments), so rows show different next-lookup times even though rounds run every 2 hours.
